workload.description: 2-turn RAG prompt with shuffled retrieval order: turn 0 = system(64) + docA(256) + docB(256) + question(64) = 640 tokens; turn 1 = system(64) + docB + docA + docC(256) + question(64) = 896 tokens. docB and docA land in swapped positions on turn 1 — the order violation a strict prefix cache cannot survive.

matched_baselines.description: Same two-turn fixture, two cache policies: prefix-only strict cache (engine#51 semantics — reusable only from the first token to the first divergence) vs the composition planner (CacheBlend-style non-prefix reuse with cross-block recomputation).

prefix_only_strict_cache.note: only the 64-token system prefix survives the docB/docA swap; everything from docB onward must be recomputed

composition_planner.compute_breakdown: 32 head windows (2 x 16) + 256 uncached docC + 64 fresh question

matched_baselines.claim: composition planner cuts turn-1 prefill from 832 to 352 tokens (-57.7%) on the same fixture, by reusing swapped-position blocks with a 16-token cross-block fusion window each

hypotheses.text: strict prefix caching collapses to system-prompt-only reuse under shuffled retrieval order
hypotheses.expected_failure_mode: if the retrieval order is stable, prefix cache retains full turns and this baseline is too strong

hypotheses.text: non-prefix composition reuse restores the majority of cached tokens with small per-chunk fusion windows
hypotheses.expected_failure_mode: if window cost scales super-linearly with chunk displacement, net savings shrink
hypotheses.observed: confirmed: 544/896 reusable (60.7%), 8.5x the prefix-only baseline, -57.7% compute

hypotheses.text: planner never admits an order-violating reuse silently (fail-closed)
hypotheses.expected_failure_mode: an unstated order dependency would produce a stale-KV reuse without a recompute decision
hypotheses.observed: confirmed: 0 silent violations; the four rejection classes in composition.rs each have a dedicated test

out_of_scope: the actual KV blending math (CacheBlend's selective token recomputation inside fused blocks — attention-side integration belongs to hanzo-engine)
multi-tenant pinning policy under budget pressure
TTFT and answer-quality parity measurement (requires the engine's attention path; this is the planning layer)
replication: git checkout the PR head; cargo run --release -p hanzo-kv-fabric --example composition_bench
